subject: Admin activity custody & geofenced export — SIG/SOC2 evidence
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood-inference.com>
To: Jack Liu <jack.liu@blueharbor.com>, Procurement <procurement@blueharbor.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Admin activity custody & geofenced export — SIG/SOC2 evidence

Jack / BlueHarbor team — thanks for the SOC 2 / SIG evidence request details. We can produce an extract of admin activity and operator/audit trails but need to align on a few constraints up front so we scope and deliver correctly: 

1) Scope: do you want the full operator/admin action ledger (create/update/delete; privilege escalations; console sessions) or a narrowed subset (user auth events + role changes + API key ops)? Please confirm time window (proposed: 2026-10-01 to 2026-11-30).

2) Geofencing / jurisdiction: you indicated exports must remain inside EU processing regions and never cross into US transit/storage. We support region-bound export (EU-only staging), but we need an approved handoff process for encrypted delivery (SFTP endpoint in eu-west with PGP + signed manifest, or Azure Blob with customer-managed key).

3) Redaction/PII: we can apply field-level redaction prior to export; provide an allowlist of fields to keep (timestamps, actor_id, action, resource_id, ip_country) and a denylist for PII to redact.

4) Proof of custody: we can produce a signed manifest (SHA256 checksums), transfer logs, and an attestation document signed by our security lead. Do you require HSM/KMS key escrow for the export key?

5) Formats & cadence: options are JSONL with iso8601 timestamps (preferred for forensic ingestion), Parquet (analytics), or a gzipped tarball with manifest. We can do an initial on-demand snapshot + incremental deltas (24h).

Please see attached summary of your requirements (evidence_requirements_blueharbor.pdf). If you confirm scope and preferred transport we’ll produce a firm delivery schedule and a pre-signed SFTP window.

Thanks,

Mateo Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood-inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachment: evidence_requirements_blueharbor.pdf (pdf, 78KB)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood-inference.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood-inference.com>, Jack Liu <jack.liu@blueharbor.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Admin activity custody & geofenced export — SIG/SOC2 evidence

Thanks Mateo — adding technical detail on export options so BlueHarbor can pick one.

Transport & encryption: we can do either
- SFTP (eu-west endpoint) with PGP-encrypted archives and an accompanying signed manifest (recommended for customers with SFTP tooling), or
- HTTPS PUT to a customer-controlled EU blob with server-side SSE-KMS where you provide the key policy for attestation.

Format & fidelity: we will include an event-level JSONL where each line is a single administrative event: {timestamp, actor_email, actor_id, action, resource_type, resource_id, session_id, ip, ip_country, metadata}. Timestamps will be ISO-8601 in UTC. For large exports we can also provide Parquet + partitioning by date.

PII redaction: default behaviour is to redact fields marked in our internal DLP list; we can apply a custom redaction map if BlueHarbor provides the list. Redactions will be recorded in the manifest (field-level mask flags).

Chain-of-custody: we’ll produce:
- SHA256 manifest for each archive
- Signed attestations (PDF) with US/EU locale statements
- Delivery log with SFTP session start/stop, bytes, and transfer checksums

KMS/HSM: if BlueHarbor needs an HSM-backed key-share for attestation, we can schedule a key-agreement call with security.

Timeline: if scope is confirmed today we can deliver a first snapshot within 5 business days and an incremental cadence thereafter.

Attachment: export_schema_v1.json (schema, 4KB)

—
Kimberly Park
Director, Platform Compliance | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood-inference.com

Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 12:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Admin activity custody & geofenced export — SIG/SOC2 evidence

Quick clarifying Qs on orchestration and scope before we lock the runbook: 

1) Sampling vs full export: do you require a full event export for the requested window or is a sampled/per-tenant scope acceptable for initial attestation? Full exports for large tenants can be very large (several hundred GB).

2) Ephemeral events: we need to confirm if ephemeral operator sessions (in-memory console traces) are in-scope — those require special handling and may only be available in compressed hourly snapshots.

3) Retention baseline: what is the BlueHarbor retention expectation for the exported bundle (e.g., store for 90 days on your side) and are there any downstream purge/return requirements?

Proposed default: full JSONL export for the requested period, delivered as a PGP-encrypted tarball to EU SFTP + signed manifest; then 24h incremental deltas for 14 days. If BlueHarbor needs longer replication windows we’ll route procurement to Sales for a Dedicated retention add-on.

I’ll prepare a short runbook and delivery checklist once scope and retention are confirmed. Vanessa, please add custody/contract language items we typically include for geofenced exports.

— Jonas
Director, Runtime Orchestration | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood-inference.com

Subject: Re: Admin activity custody & geofenced export — SIG/SOC2 evidence

Thanks all — this looks good and detailed, appreciate the options. A few decisions from Legal/Procurement: 

- Scope: full admin activity ledger for 2026-10-01 through 2026-11-30 inclusive.
- Transport: EU SFTP with PGP-encrypted tarball. Provide the SFTP endpoint and a public key fingerprint.
- Redaction: default redaction is fine but please do NOT redact actor_email; we need actor identity mapped to our vendor accounts.
- Retention: BlueHarbor will retain the export for 90 days; we will purge per our policy and confirm back to Redwood.
- Proof-of-delivery: provide a signed manifest (SHA256 checksums), transfer logs, and a DocuSign attestation confirming the export was generated and handoff completed. Also include a delivery window (preferred 2026-12-10 between 09:00-12:00 CET).

We’ve attached a signed PO that authorizes the work and includes the NDR language (blueharbor_po_signed.pdf). Please confirm the SFTP contact and any pre-flight checklist items and we’ll confirm the delivery window.

Thanks,
Jack Liu
Senior Procurement Manager | BlueHarbor Health
jack.liu@blueharbor.com

Attachment: blueharbor_po_signed.pdf (pdf, 120KB)
